title: Defense Slide Budget & Speaking Pace Planner

content.intro: Use the interactive Defense Slide Budget & Speaking Pace Planner below to rehearse your 15-minute presentation. Set your planned slide count and speaking words-per-minute rate to verify that you finish with confidence inside your committee's strict time limit.
key: Standard speaking rate under mild adrenaline is 130 to 140 words per minute.
A 15-minute defense allows a maximum spoken script of 1,800 to 2,000 words across all slides.
Always leave 60 seconds of buffer before the 15:00 buzzer sounds.
